The CMYK ICC profile this crate embeds (src/default_cmyk.icc) is
CGATS001Compat-v2-micro.icc from Clinton Ingram's Compact ICC Profiles
collection, byte-identical to
https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles/blob/1fabe4a41b/profiles/CGATS001Compat-v2-micro.icc
(8464 bytes, SHA-256
73e1ba37d2bad5bab2a964f40a9eed96209666efc067c3322626214bbef234a0).
Its own copyright tag reads "CC0".

It is not covered by this crate's Apache-2.0 OR MIT licence. That
collection's README releases it to the public domain:

    All profiles in this collection are released to the public domain
    under the Creative Commons CC0 license. They are free from
    restrictions on distribution and use to the extent allowed by law.

The CC0 1.0 Universal legal code is at
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

The file keeps the name default_cmyk.icc because it stands where
Ghostscript's profile of that name once stood. It is not that profile and
contains nothing from it: Ghostscript's default_cmyk.icc is 187484 bytes,
describes itself as "Artifex CMYK SWOP Profile", and carries an Artifex
copyright. The profile here is built from the CGATS TR 001-1995 (SWOP)
characterisation data.
